newsitem.title: GERMANY: Germany says weak mark to boost jobs, growth.
newsitem.headline: Germany says weak mark to boost jobs, growth.

text.p: The rise of the dollar and sterling against the mark is improving Germany's competitive position and will boost growth and jobs without creating inflationary dangers, a government spokesman said on Wednesday.
"In sum, there will be a positive effect on growth and employment; the stability of prices is not endangered," German government spokesman Peter Hausmann said responding to Reuters enquiries.
Hausmann was speaking after a regular government news conference at which he reported on a discussion in cabinet about developments on foreign exchange markets.

"Through the strength of the U.S. dollar and the British pound the German export industry's ability to compete on prices has improved in these markets, but also in Southeast Asia, and has worsened for those who import from dollar and pound regions," he said.
He added, however, that around 10 percent of German exports and 20 percent of imports were calculated in dollars.
